company.name: Lucid Bots
company.shortDescription: Lucid Bots is a technology company that develops autonomous robotic systems designed for industrial cleaning and exterior maintenance tasks.
company.description: Lucid Bots is a technology company that develops autonomous robotic systems designed for industrial cleaning and exterior maintenance tasks. It provides drones and robotic platforms used for applications such as building facade cleaning, window washing, and pressure washing in commercial environments. The company integrates software, sensors, and navigation systems to enable controlled and repeatable operations with reduced manual intervention. Its product offerings include hardware units, operator training, and support services for deployment and ongoing use. Lucid Bots also focuses on improving safety conditions by minimizing the need for workers to perform tasks at height or in hazardous environments.

aiResearchSummary.text: The work titled System for discharging a liquid component from a remote operated vehicle and its abstract describe a system for controlled release of liquid from a remote operated vehicle using an integrated valve system and valve body. This aligns with robots for labor intensive tasks by enabling robotic platforms to manage fluids for cleaning, spraying, or other liquid handling operations. Lucid Bots is researching and developing remote operated robotic systems for liquid discharge and fluid control in operational environments.
